It is more memory-efficient than pure voxel methods like 3DGS but less efficient than pure mesh methods like MERF in terms of disk storage [S1, unofficial].

The claim states that Vosh is more memory-efficient than 3DGS but less efficient than MERF in terms of disk storage. According to Source [S1], the disk storage for 3DGS is 1270 MB, for Vosh-Base is 488 MB, and for MERF is 149 MB. Since 488 MB < 1270 MB, Vosh is more efficient than 3DGS. Since 488 MB > 149 MB, Vosh is less efficient than MERF. The text explicitly confirms this: 'Disk storage is slightly larger than MERF because Vosh uses the classic voxel representation... instead of MERF's core triplane representation'. Thus, all facts in the claim are supported by the evidence.

The text directly supports every part of the claim.
